purpose: Evaluate contract-first figure production, traceability, export, integration, and visual QA.

cases.task: Create a manuscript-ready quantitative figure from an analysis table.
Restyle and re-export an existing manuscript figure.
must_include: canonical output or explicit version decision
must_not: create an unrelated generator without checking reuse

cases.task: Promote a revised figure into a report and demote its old version.
must_include: updated link caption alt text and numbering
must_not: edit report links without checking targets
treat placement as final without user-confirmed figure logic

cases.task: Crop a source image into a panel and replace the report-facing copy.
must_include: preserved labels scale and semantic context
statement that evidence strength is unchanged
must_not: crop away contradictory observations without disclosure

cases.task: Export a Markdown report with local figures to PDF.
must_include: PDF signature page and image checks
must_not: expose private contact details without review
replace the source report unless requested
